source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest

items.name: Caustic Drool
items.text:
Caustic saliva drips from the warhound's mouth. Until the end of its turn, the abyssal warhound's jaws Strike deals an additional 2 points of acid damage on a successful attack, or 4 points on a critical success.

Effect: Caustic Drool

items.name: Caustic Vomit
items.text: The abyssal warhound purebred spews acidic vomit that deals 9d6 acid damage in a 40-foot cone (DC 25 basic Fortitude save save). It can't use Caustic Vomit again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Shake
items.text:
Requirements The abyssal warhound's Caustic Drool ability is active

---

Effect The warhound shakes its head, splattering nearby creatures with caustic saliva. All creatures within 10 feet of the warhound take 5d6 acid damage (DC 23 basic Reflex save) and the warhound's Caustic Drool ability ends. Abyssal warhounds are immune to this damage.

items.name: Warning Growl
items.text:
Trigger A creature targets the warhound with a melee Strike

---

Effect The warhound Demoralizes the triggering creature and does not take a penalty for not speaking a language. The results of this check occur before resolving the triggering Strike.
